sizeDisclosure: Below the S4.D 300-1000-page soft target (~180 estimated pages across 3 documents). This is a real, disclosed characteristic of this specific facility (a bespoke bilateral crypto-asset-collateralized loan between one borrower and one lender), not an extraction defect and not a reason to re-select: the deterministic selection procedure (04-selection-proof.json) was already finalized before any page-count information was known, and re-rolling post-hoc based on realized size would itself be exactly the kind of selection-bias the governing spec's S4/S5 forbid. Structural signal check confirms real substantive content: 70-76 numbered Sections per document, Article I 'DEFINITIONS AND ACCOUNTING TERMS', Article II 'AMOUNTS AND TERMS OF THE ADVANCE', at least one Conditions article, 13 'covenant' mentions, 29 'Lien' mentions, 32-33 'Default' mentions, 24 'shall not' prohibitions, 30 loan-to-value/LTV mentions, 5 margin-call mentions (this facility's financial/ratio mechanism is LTV-and-margin-call-based rather than a traditional leverage-ratio financial covenant - a genuinely different but real covenant architecture, itself a meaningful generalization test).

freezeStatement: This manifest is frozen at commit time. No document will be added or removed based on how the pipeline or ground-truth review performs. A later-discovered objectively-required missing document (e.g., an unfiled security/pledge agreement referenced by these three documents) will be disclosed as PACKAGE_MANIFEST_INCOMPLETE, never silently repaired mid-validation.
